touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: A useful, well-served village beside an excellent country park, but the village fabric is not itself a 60+ destination.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Public outdoor routes can form part of a dog visit, with ordinary close-control restrictions around roads, wildlife and shared spaces.

townGuide.headline: A recorded locality rather than a tourist destination
townGuide.intro: Balmedie Beach and Country Park is a major separate See attraction; its visitor value is not transferred wholesale to the modern residential village.
perfectFor: Identifying the locality while planning a wider route
townGuide.visitorMood: Kept in the selector for completeness, but deliberately absent from the tourist-town map below 60.

features.name: Balmedie Beach and Country Park
features.shortDescription: A major dune-backed beach with boardwalks, five waymarked routes, play space, picnic tables, free parking, accessible toilets and beach wheelchairs.
